battle.name: 馬格里布叛亂
battle.brief: 馬格里布叛亂為2002年摩洛哥北部里夫地區爆發的反抗事件，居民與青年在阿爾侯塞馬等地示威，要求改善經濟與政治待遇，武警出動鎮壓。別丹步槍（Berdan rifle）為1866年列裝的栓動步槍，曾大量出口並為多國軍隊採用，屬本條目可對照的軍備型號。

kit.name: 別丹步槍
kit.history: 別丹步槍為俄羅斯帝國陸軍1866年採用的栓動步槍，替代前線步兵舊式火槍，成為帝國陸軍步兵制式武器，後經大量出口流傳多國軍隊。

countries: 本篇所稱的「馬格里布叛亂」，是英文資料通常標作 Marib Rebellion (2002) 的 2002 年 10 月也門事件，中文亦常寫作「馬里卜叛亂」，並非北非馬格里布地區的衝突。交戰主體一方是掌握首都薩那與國家軍令體系的也門共和國政府軍，另一方是由第1裝甲師部分駐軍在穆爾希德·阿卜西指揮下發動的馬里卜叛軍。馬里卜位於也門中部高原東緣，既控制薩那通往哈德拉毛方向的交通節點，又擁有可供裝甲部隊展開的城郊高地與機場；因此，奪取馬里卜不是單純爭取一座城，而是試圖切斷中央軍在東部的主要陸路與航空節點。
countriesEn: The 'Mughrib rebellion' discussed here is the October 2002 Yemeni event generally listed in English as the Marib Rebellion (2002), also rendered in Chinese as the 'Marib rebellion'; it was not a conflict in North Africa's Maghreb. One side was the government forces of the Republic of Yemen, which controlled Sana'a and the national command system. The other was the Marib rebel force led in part by elements of the 1st Armoured Division under Murshid al-Absi. Marib stood on the eastern edge of Yemen's central highlands and controlled a transport junction leading from Sana'a toward Hadramawt, while its surrounding high ground and airfield allowed an armoured formation to operate. Taking Marib therefore meant challenging a major road and aviation node in eastern Yemen, not merely occupying a town.
people: 指揮核心是總統阿里·阿卜杜拉·薩利赫與第1裝甲師指揮官穆爾希德·阿卜西。薩利赫掌握首都、總參謀部、空軍與全國後勤調度，能把數個師級單位從不同方向集中到馬里卜；阿卜西則因掌握駐軍、裝甲兵器和當地陣地，在起事第一階段取得主動。公開資料常把第3機械化師等中央直屬部隊、特種部隊、炮兵及航空兵列入政府軍作戰序列，但沒有可靠文獻足以確認整場戰役只有一位前線指揮官。第1裝甲師也不是毫無例外地整體倒戈，師內出現分裂，叛軍只掌握其中部分營、旅及可用裝甲，使中央軍能從外部逐段削弱其火力，而不必立即投入一次總攻。
peopleEn: The central figures were President Ali Abdullah Saleh and the 1st Armoured Division commander Murshid al-Absi. Saleh controlled the capital, the General Staff, the air force and national logistics, allowing him to concentrate several division-sized formations on Marib from different approaches. Al-Absi initially held the initiative because he controlled the garrison, its armoured weapons and the surrounding positions. Public accounts repeatedly include the 3rd Mechanized Division and other centrally controlled formations, special forces, artillery and aviation in the government order of battle, but no reliable record establishes a single commander for the entire loyalist column. Nor did the entire 1st Armoured Division defect as one unit. Internal divisions limited the rebels to parts of several battalions or brigades and whatever armour remained usable, enabling the government to weaken them from outside rather than immediately attempting one frontal assault.
kits: 能由也門軍在2002年以前的裝備序列核對的核心型號，包括叛軍所依托的 T-55AMV／T-55、T-62 系列、BMP-1、BTR-60／BTR-70，以及政府方面可投入的 T-55、T-62、T-72 系列；部分資料亦列有 BMP-2，但各型的確切數量、可用率及是否全部到場，沒有公開清單。炮兵方面，也門已列裝 122毫米 D-30、BM-21「Grad」系列、152毫米 2S1「Gvozdika」和155毫米 M101。航空裝備包括 Su-22M3、Mi-8 與 Mi-24D／V，但公開戰報不足以證明每一型都參加本役射擊。彈藥須按武器分開保障：T-55與T-62使用115公厘炮彈，T-72使用125公厘，BMP-1配73公厘，BMP-2配30公厘，BTR-60／70配14.5公厘；122、152及155公厘炮彈也不能互相替代。2S1可隨裝甲縱隊自行展開，M101則需要牽引車、相應供彈車和足夠柴油。
kitsEn: The principal types that can be checked against Yemeni inventories before 2002 include the T-55AMV and T-55, T-62 series, BMP-1 and BTR-60/BTR-70 relied upon by the rebels, as well as government T-55, T-62 and T-72 series vehicles. Some accounts also list BMP-2, but no public inventory establishes the exact strength, readiness rate or whether every vehicle reached the battlefield. Yemen had already fielded 122mm D-30 and BM-21 'Grad' systems, 152mm 2S1 'Gvozdika' guns and 155mm M101 howitzers. Its aviation inventory included the Su-22M3, Mi-8 and Mi-24D/V, although surviving reports do not prove that every type conducted combat sorties in this campaign. Ammunition had to be supplied by weapon: T-55 and T-62 tanks used 115mm rounds, T-72 tanks used 125mm, BMP-1 carried 73mm, BMP-2 carried 30mm and BTR-60/70 vehicles used 14.5mm ammunition. The 122mm, 152mm and 155mm rounds were likewise distinct. The 2S1 could deploy with an armoured column, whereas M101 batteries required towing vehicles, ammunition carriers and adequate diesel support.
tactics: 起義的第一階段不是直接進攻薩那，而是先奪取駐地與交通樞紐。叛軍控制馬里卜軍用機場、營區及通往城郊的主要路口，使政府原本用於部隊輪換和後勤補給的東部路線失去秩序；中央軍則從薩那經拉達、瓦迪達蘭方向集中，這條公路約250公里，山地與沙漠路段使車隊必須分批行進並安排油料、用水和防空警戒。作戰上，政府軍先封鎖道路、蒐集情報及建立炮兵射擊陣地，再由機械化步兵、坦克和工兵沿主要道路接近。叛軍利用既設陣地防守，以 T-55作短距離反衝擊，以 BMP及 BTR輸送武裝人員，並把砲兵固定在可支援道路的陣地。當機場、補給點和東側出口相繼受壓，防線便由完整收縮為孤立據點；政府軍完成局部突破、奪取機場和指揮節點後，再肅清城郊殘餘陣地。
tacticsEn: The opening phase was not an immediate march on Sana'a. It was an attempt to seize the garrison and its transport links. The rebels secured the Marib military airfield, barracks and principal approaches from the outskirts, disrupting the eastern routes previously used for troop rotation and logistics. Loyal forces then concentrated from Sana'a through the direction of Rada and Wadi Daran, a road of roughly 250 kilometres whose mountain and desert sections required the columns to move in stages while arranging fuel, water and air defence. Tactically, the government first blocked roads, gathered intelligence and established artillery positions before moving mechanised infantry, tanks and engineers along the main axis. The rebels relied on prepared positions, using T-55s for short counterattacks, BMP and BTR vehicles to move armed personnel, and fixed artillery positions covering the roads. Once the airfield, supply points and eastern exits came under pressure, the perimeter contracted into disconnected strongpoints. After breaking through selected sectors and taking the airfield and command points, government forces cleared the remaining positions around Marib.
data: 公開資料對起訖日期偶有相差一日的標法，但較穩健的時間線是：10月4日，阿卜西所部在馬里卜發動叛亂，控制軍用機場、營區及第1裝甲師部分駐地；10月5日，薩那方面確認兵變，開始封鎖交通、召回忠于中央的部隊並轉移炮兵與航空兵；10月6日，以第3機械化師等為主的中央部隊被調往拉達及瓦迪達蘭方向，建立集結與補給區；10月7日至9日，雙方在城郊、機場和東側公路周圍反覆爭奪，政府軍先以炮兵壓制，再由裝甲與機械化步兵推進；10月10日，叛軍核心陣地及補給線相繼失守，抵抗明顯下降；10月11日前後，政府軍重新掌握馬里卜主要行政區與機場，叛亂在組織層面結束。薩那至馬里卜公路約250公里，但沒有可靠文件足以逐一重建每個連隊的出發、抵達及彈藥消耗，故不能把每日推進寫成完全沒有歧義的單一路線。各方傷亡數字互相矛盾，也缺乏獨立核驗，因此不列無法確認的精確總數。
dataEn: Public sources occasionally differ by a day in their start and end dates, but the most stable reconstruction is as follows: on 4 October, al-Absi's force launched the rebellion in Marib and took the military airfield, barracks and parts of the 1st Armoured Division's garrison. On 5 October, Sana'a confirmed the mutiny, began restricting movement, recalled units loyal to the central government and shifted artillery and aviation assets. On 6 October, centrally controlled formations centred on the 3rd Mechanized Division and other units were directed toward Rada and Wadi Daran to establish assembly and supply areas. From 7 to 9 October, both sides fought repeatedly around the outskirts, airfield and eastern road, with government artillery suppressing rebel positions before armour and mechanised infantry advanced. On 10 October, the principal rebel positions and supply routes fell in succession and organised resistance declined markedly. By about 11 October, government forces again held the main administrative district and airfield, ending the rebellion as an organised military effort. The Sana'a-Marib road is approximately 250 kilometres long, but no reliable document reconstructs every unit's departure, arrival and ammunition expenditure. Conflicting casualty claims also lack independent verification, so no unconfirmed precise total is given.
cause: 最可信的背景不是單一政策口號，而是薩利赫中央政府與資深軍方指揮官之間的權力分配衝突。1994年也門內戰後，總統逐步削弱其他軍系與政治派系的獨立能力；此時仍握有裝甲部隊的師級指揮員，不只是作戰指揮者，也控制兵員調配、裝備配發、軍職晉升及地方軍政資源。第1裝甲師的分裂，反映中央整編、地方利益和指揮權安排之間的矛盾。直接誘因可能包括人事調整、待遇與裝備分配爭議，以及中央對馬里卜一帶資源和軍政崗位的控制，但現有公開材料不足以排列這些因素，也無法證明某一事件是唯一導火線。叛軍能迅速起事，是因為它先控制駐紮地、武器庫與既有防線；它未能擴大為全國性戰爭，則是因為仍依賴一個師級單位，且政府掌握更大兵力與完整道路、空運和後勤體系。
causeEn: The most credible background was a struggle over the distribution of power between Saleh's central government and senior commanders rather than any single ideological slogan. After the 1994 Yemeni Civil War, the presidency progressively weakened the independent position of rival military factions and political groups. Division commanders who still controlled armoured formations were therefore not merely battlefield leaders: they also influenced personnel assignments, equipment distribution, promotion, patronage and local military-administrative resources. The split within the 1st Armoured Division reflected tension between centralising reforms, local interests and command arrangements. Possible immediate triggers included personnel changes, disputes over pay and equipment, and central control of posts and resources around Marib, but surviving public material cannot rank these factors or identify one event as the sole trigger. The rebels could rise quickly because they already controlled the garrison, weapons depots and prepared defences. They could not turn the revolt into a nationwide war because they still depended heavily on one division, while the government retained greater manpower and an intact road, air-transport and logistics system.
impact: 直接軍事結果是馬里卜與其機場重新置於中央控制，第1裝甲師因而必須解除、整編或重新編配，涉案指揮官亦遭撤職、拘捕或調離，原有以師級單位為核心的權力網絡被削弱。這場叛亂沒有改變國家領導層，也沒有建立可持續的替代軍政府；政府仍保有指揮部、制空權與主要後勤節點。從戰術層面看，叛軍依靠既有陣地和裝甲進行短期抵抗，卻未能讓機場、海路與長距離車隊同時運作；政府軍則用封鎖、炮兵準備和分批推進逐步切斷其機動空間。較長期的影響是中央軍對裝甲師忠誠、指揮官任免和重裝備供應的管制更加緊密，也門軍隊內部的政治分權進一步收窄。此次事件證明控制一個重要駐地不足以直接奪取國家權力，但足以在短時間內形成對首都的軍事威脅。
impactEn: The immediate military effect was that Marib and its airfield returned to central control. The 1st Armoured Division consequently had to be disarmed, reorganised or reconstituted, while officers connected with the revolt were removed, detained or transferred, weakening the power network formerly centred on the division. The rebellion neither changed the national leadership nor created a durable rival military government; the government retained its command headquarters, air superiority and principal logistical nodes. Tactically, the rebels used existing positions and armour for short-term resistance but could not keep the airfield, road network and long-distance convoys functioning together. Loyal forces instead used blocking operations, artillery preparation and phased advances to reduce the rebels' room for manoeuvre. A longer-term consequence was tighter central supervision of armoured-division loyalty, senior appointments and heavy-equipment supply, further narrowing political pluralism inside the armed forces. The episode demonstrated that control of an important garrison could create a serious short-term threat to the capital without providing the means to seize national power.
result: 結局是也門中央政府的軍事勝利，而非政治妥協。叛軍失去主要營區、馬里卜機場及通往外部的道路控制，參與部隊由統一作戰轉為分散抵抗，隨後被解除、投降、逃散或併入重新整編的單位；第1裝甲師原有指揮體系亦告瓦解。政府之所以能在約一週內扭轉局面，主要依靠三項條件：中央軍在兵力與重裝備上佔優，薩那至馬里卜的公路和航空補給維持忠誠部隊作戰，而叛軍未能突破自身駐地及師級編制的限制。應把結果理解為叛亂被鎮壓及軍事指揮網被清除，而不是把所有涉案人員都視為戰死；可靠資料無法支持一個精確傷亡總數。馬里卜重回政府控制，叛軍未形成跨區政治聯盟，中央軍的戰役指揮與後勤體系亦未因此崩潰。
resultEn: The outcome was a military victory for Yemen's central government rather than a political compromise. The rebels lost their principal barracks, Marib airfield and roads connecting them to the outside. Their formations fragmented from coordinated operations into isolated resistance, after which personnel were disarmed, surrendered, dispersed or incorporated into reorganised units, and the original command structure of the 1st Armoured Division was broken. The government reversed the situation in roughly a week through three principal advantages: superior manpower and heavy equipment, the ability to sustain loyal forces through the Sana'a-Marib road and air routes, and the rebels' inability to escape the constraints of their garrison and division-level organisation. The result should be understood as the suppression of the revolt and destruction of its military command network, not as proof that every participant was killed in combat; surviving evidence does not support a precise casualty total. Marib returned to government control, the rebels failed to create a trans-regional political alliance, and the central military command and logistics system did not collapse.
